subject: general
question: From each of the four corners of a rectangular sheet of dimensions 48 cm × 27 cm, a square of side 3.5 cm is cut off and a box is made. The volume of the box is:
solution:
**Given:**

Length = 48 cm

Breadth = 27 cm

Height = 3.5 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of the box = l × b × h

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8ff83e046c3fa938368d8c79f44f764f70efffc12aba9cb9115916cc5ed9a5c.png] 

Length of the box = [48 – (2 × 3.5)] = (48 – 7)

⇒ 41 cm

Breadth of the box = [27 – (2 × 3.5)] = (27 – 7)

⇒ 20 cm

Height of the box = 3.5 cm

Now,

Volume of the box = (41 × 20 × 3.5) cm³

⇒ 2870 cm³

**∴ The volume of the box is 2870 cm³**
